reason_for_successor: Phase 1 stopped because one held free-agent-only player's frozen current position had reverted. The current-core candidate itself had no position-integrity failure. Phase 1B rebases scope to the production-core population instead of modifying the failed Phase 1 result.
cohort_rule: From every player in the immutable deployed IDP V1 transport artifact, select rows that (a) currently render in the production-parity core valuation universe, (b) have an authoritative current generated position in DL/LB/DB, and (c) that current position differs from legacy_model_position.
important: Cohort membership is determined only from identity, current production scope, and current position before candidate movement is evaluated. Free-agent-only and non-rendered players are outside Phase 1B scope and remain untouched.
current_position_authority: scripts/artifacts/generated/player_positions.json, cross-checked against production-parity live merged PLAYER_DB
frozen_model_inputs: immutable deployed IDP V1 history artifact
immutable deployed IDP V1 forward projection stored in transport artifact
immutable deployed IDP V1 replacement baselines
candidate_method: Transport only the clean current-position-minus-legacy-position V1 model delta onto the current deployed raw PROD_MULT.
holds: current-core cohort row without comparable frozen V1 projection/model evidence
movement_policy: Magnitude and rank movement are diagnostics only. Phase 1 already exposed approximate movement, so Phase 1B does not retrofit movement thresholds after observing those results.
hard_gates: immutable deployed IDP V1 release hashes intact
failed Phase 1 artifacts remain intact and retain STOP decision
current-core cohort nonempty and uniquely identified
authoritative current position equals live merged PLAYER_DB position for every cohort row
legacy_model_position differs from authoritative current position for every cohort row
current deployed raw PROD_MULT equals the deployed IDP V1 raw multiplier for every cohort row
every cohort row becomes a candidate or documented hold
all candidate FVs finite positive integers
raw PROD_MULT direction does not cause opposite-direction FV movement
zero FV changes outside frozen Phase 1B cohort
